messages:
Michael: FYI — onboarding HF jinja chat_template -> Redwood prompt for mosaic-7b-q has a role/BOS mismatch causing eval regressions on our chat-quality-suite. PPL up ~12% on conv tasks.

Sarah: can you paste the template + tokenizer config?

Michael: pasted snippet:
```jinja
{% for msg in messages %}
{{ msg.role }}: {{ msg.content }}
{% endfor %}
```
And config.json excerpt:
```json
{"add_bos_token": false, "eos_token": "<|endoftext|>"}
```
Looks like HF default inserts BOS when add_bos_token=true; ours expects explicit <s> as bos. When add_bos_token=false the first system message lost its leading token and tokenization collapsed with user text.

Javi: maybe the jinja loop is rendering role labels into the content (i.e. 'system:' literal) — Redwood expects role metadata, not inline role labels. Are you transforming chat_template->messages structure or flattening to single prompt?

Michael: We're flattening into single prompt via conversion util. The helper was emitting 'system: ...' text. That plus tokenizer not having bos made model treat system as user. Repro: see `convert_hf_chat_to_redwood(jinja_str)` -> output starts with 'system: You are ...'

Eva: ohhh that explains the quality drop. Also with 4-bit quant we lose some instruction-following fidelity, so mixing role-as-text is worse. Quick fix: ensure conversion produces structured messages array instead of role prefix, or add bos token back.

Sarah: simple patch: detect leading 'system:'/ '^assistant:' and set role field accordingly. Also update tokenizer.json to include "bos_token":"<s>", "eos_token":"</s>". Can you try a patch on the branch?

Michael: pushed patch to feat/hf-chat-conv 1765001250; ran run_eval.sh — initial delta: PPL back to baseline, but a few low-rank responses still odd. Leaving notes in PR.

deploy-bot: CI: eval-suite failed on model-metrics (job 4872). Check logs: /ci/logs/4872 — tokenization mismatch.

Javi: adding test case to prevent regression: include a template where system is empty block `{% if system %}{{ system }}{% endif %}` which used to be removed.

Eva: Also add tokenizer.roundtrip test for special tokens and a tiny quantization smoke test: 4-bit -> generate deterministic answer for a seed prompt.

Michael: thanks all :thumbsup: I'll revert conversion path where necessary and coordinate with infra for a staged deploy.
